is_playing.docs: This Condition returns true while playback is active.

gain.docs:
**Percentage**: With this value you can set the volume of the sound.

*See also: [RTTTL Buzzer](https://esphome.io/components/rtttl#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the RTTTL if you have multiple components.

*See also: [RTTTL Buzzer](https://esphome.io/components/rtttl#configuration-variables)*

on_finished_playback.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when playback is finished.

*See also: [RTTTL Buzzer](https://esphome.io/components/rtttl#configuration-variables)*

output.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the [float output](https://esphome.io/components/output) to use for this buzzer.

*See also: [RTTTL Buzzer](https://esphome.io/components/rtttl#configuration-variables)*

speaker.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker) to play the song on.

*See also: [RTTTL Buzzer](https://esphome.io/components/rtttl#configuration-variables)*
